comments.author: V_I
comments.body:
I learned this tech while fighting enemies in the new Abu Simbel lower floor "danger room". You know, the hidden room with lots of NPCs in a wide open space? It costs 120 Gauge, has a range of 100, and the third range shows 90. I'm not sure what the difference is between those two ranges apart from the icons. The requirements are:

12 Search, 10 Archaeology, Range Pit Trap

I had that much Search, but 13+3 Archaeology at the time of the skill acquisition. The enemies never used the tech once during our battle, though. Like Wystein posted under another tech, there's more than one kind of enemy who you can learn this tech from, shown on this list: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Combat/Technic

comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
After the release with chapter 3 of Atlantis (Acropolis), the conditions for obtaining this tech is now:

Trap rank 7
Archaeology rank 7
Range Pit Trap

Note: This tech is used by the npc's in Lima medium hidden floors at punishment room.

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body:
I tried learning this from the punishment room in lower Abu Simbel as V_I claimed, but I couldn't get the NPCs to use ANY techs, much less this one, on me no matter how much I tried to provoke them. I had better luck in the Punishment room in Lima mid.

To get them to use it, try provoking the Lima Grave Robber Lv65 (they use swords) with a Power or Quick battle-tech. This will cause them to counteract it with techs of their own on you, but it has a high chance of the Lima Grave Robber Lv67 NPCs (they use throwing knives) of using this tech on you. Be careful as they can use this multiple times on you, causing you to get trapped and be killed (they also love to use Dionysus' Wine a lot as well to further add to it). If your not a high enough level to resist it, I suggest getting a fleet member or two to assist you with this.
